description: Point this running server at another Godot project, so the following tool calls work on it — one MCP registration for many games. Only projects below the folders given with --projects-root are allowed (without it the server stays on its --project). Returns the new project's status like godot_status, or, when no editor is open for it, how to open one. The previous project's editor and game keep running. Don't switch while another tool call runs.

path.description: Project folder (the one with project.godot): absolute, ~/..., or relative to a projects root, e.g. 'games/shooter'.

name: project_connect
title: Switch project
